title: Override-Vulnerable Inheritance Contracts
pattern: Overriding a method that has preconditions, postconditions, or class invariants in languages that do not automatically propagate Design by Contract assertions.
why_bad: The contract is not automatically enforced. Subclass maintainers must remember to manually duplicate and call the invariants, leading to silent invariant violations in overridden methods.
detection: An overridden method does not call the base class's assertion checks or base invariants upon entry or exit.
counterexample: The programming language automatically executes the base preconditions and invariants, or the Template Method pattern is used to prevent overriding the contract check.
fix: Use the Template Method Pattern: Keep the contract-checking method final and have it call a private virtual method `do_set_speed` for subclass implementations.
